_note: Convention taken from OutputBox/COSTING/ (flat, no dated subfolders): '{Vendor} -  {InvoiceNumber}.pdf'. The separator is space-hyphen-SPACE-SPACE. Vendor casing is NOT normalised in the live data -- 'BEG4KLOTHING, INC' and 'Beg4Kloathing, Inc' are the same vendor spelled two ways. STILL DISABLED: the invoice number extracts reliably from the 'INVOICE NO.' label, but the vendor name does NOT. Letterheads are the most OCR-corrupted part of these pages (large stylised fonts scan worst): 'IDEAL GROUP HOLDINGS LIMITED' reads as 'IDf,AL GROUP HOLDINGS LIMITED' and 'MOLAX TRADING LIMITED' as 'i,lOLAX TRADING LIIMITED'. Only some invoices carry a 'VENDOR' label. A vendor lookup keyed on the invoice-number prefix is the viable fix and needs the business to supply the canonical vendor list.
